title: Same Target, Different Origins: Aligning Latent Rollout for Consistent PDE Emulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21370v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural PDE solvers commonly generate multi-step predictions through autoregressive rollout, recursively applying a learned evolution operator and feeding each prediction back as input for the next step. Approximation errors can therefore propagate through the rollout, causing predictions at a shared target time to depend on their temporal origins and rollout depths. For a well-posed deterministic PDE flow, however, states at different times along the same physical trajectory should, under exact evolution, reach the same target state. translated_title: 相同目标，不同起点：对齐潜在推演以实现一致的偏微分方程仿真
translated_abstract: 神经偏微分方程（PDE）求解器通常通过自回归推演生成多步预测，即递归地应用学习到的演化算子，并将每一步的预测反馈作为下一步的输入。因此，近似误差会在推演过程中传播，导致在同一目标时刻的预测依赖于其时间起点和推演深度。然而，对于适定的确定性PDE流，同一物理轨迹上不同时刻的状态在精确演化下应到达相同的目标状态。为此，我们提出了对齐潜在推演，这是一种正则化方法，通过神经PDE求解器的内部表示来促进不同推演起点之间的一致性。对潜在差异传播的二阶泰勒分析引出了两个优化目标：零阶潜在状态一致性，即在同一目标时刻对齐表示；以及一阶潜在动力学一致性，即在潜在空间中对齐演化趋势。
tldr: 提出ALR正则化方法，通过对神经PDE求解器的潜在表示施加零阶状态一致性与一阶动力学一致性约束，使不同起点和深度的自回归推演在同一目标时刻收敛到一致的预测，从而抑制误差在多步推演中的传播。
en_tdlr: We propose ALR, a regularization method that enforces zeroth-order latent state consistency and first-order latent dynamics consistency in neural PDE solvers' internal representations, ensuring autoregressive rollouts from different origins and depths converge to consistent predictions at the same target time.
